methods.name: AlexNet and U-Net convolutional neural networks
methods.summary: The authors trained two existing CNN architectures, AlexNet and U-Net, using optical (Sentinel-2) and topographic (TanDEM-X) data to detect giant landslides. The networks were trained on five landform classes (plateaus, plateau edges, landslide deposits, talus, and plains) using a multi-class approach, with results interpolated using 'mode' or 'fill' methods.
